items.title: Udilo Aruṇa Pūraba Bhāge — Aruṇodaya-kīrtana Song 1
items.author: Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura
items.source: Gītāvalī, Aruṇodaya-kīrtana Song 1 (kīrtana songs to be sung at dawn)
items.chanting_mood: Pre-dawn awakening to the Name — the foundational morning bhajan.
items.audio_note: Direct recording not yet pinned. Browse Songs of the Spiritual Masters (Vol-01) for Prabhupāda's rendering — companion song Jiv Jāgo (Aruṇodaya-kīrtana II) is in the same folder.
items.meditation_for_japa:
Sing or read this bhajan at brāhma-muhūrta before the first round.
It places you in the company of Lord Caitanya as He walks through
Navadvīpa, calling devotees to wake up and chant. Let that scene
carry into your beads.

verses.iast:
udilo aruṇa pūraba-bhāge,
dwija-maṇi gorā amani jāge,
bhakata-samūha loiyā sāthe,
gelā nagara-vrāje
verses.translation:
When the rising sun appeared in the East, the jewel of the
twice-born, Lord Gaurasundara, awakened, and, taking His
devotees with Him, He went all over the countryside towns and
villages.

verses.iast:
'tāthāi tāthāi bājalo khol,
ghana ghana tāhe jhājera rol,
preme ḍhala ḍhala soṅāra aṅga,
caraṇe nūpura bāje
verses.translation:
The mṛdaṅgas (khol) resounded "tāthāi, tāthāi," and the jhājhas
(large metal karatālas that look like small cymbals) joined in
time. Lord Gaurāṅga's golden form swayed in ecstatic love of
Godhead, and His footbells jingled.

verses.iast:
mukunda mādhava yādava hari,
bolena bolo re vadana bhori',
miche nida-baśe gelo re rāti,
divasa śarīra-sāje
verses.translation:
All the devotees chanted the names Mukunda, Mādhava, Yādava and
Hari, their mouths being filled with the vibrations. He loudly
announced to the still sleeping people, "You spend your nights
uselessly sleeping and your days decorating your bodies!"

verses.iast:
emana durlabha mānava-deho,
pāiyā ki koro bhāva nā keho,
ebe nā bhajile yaśodā-suta,
carame paḍibe lāje
verses.translation:
You have achieved such a rare human body, but you do not care
for this gift. You remain not serving the darling of Yaśodā
and slowly fall through your last moments to death.

verses.iast:
udita tapana hoile asta,
dina gelo boli' hoibe byasta,
tabe keno ebe alasa hoy,
nā bhaja hṛdoya-rāje
verses.translation:
With every rising and setting of the sun, a day passes and is
lost. Then, why do you remain idle and not serve the Lord of
the heart?

verses.iast:
jīvana anitya jānaha sār,
tāhe nānā-vidha vipada-bhār,
nāmāśraya kori' jatane tumi,
thākaha āpana kāje
verses.translation:
This temporary life is full of various miseries. Take shelter
of the holy name as your only business.

verses.iast:
jīvera kalyāṇa-sādhana-kām,
jagate āsi' e madhura nām,
avidyā-timira-tapana-rūpe,
hṛd-gagane birāje
verses.translation:
To penetrate the darkness of ignorance and bless everyone's
heart, the holy name has risen like the shining sun.

verses.iast:
kṛṣṇa-nāma-sudhā koriyā pān,
jurāo bhakativinoda-prān,
nāma binā kichu nāhiko āro,
caudda-bhuvana-mājhe
verses.translation:
Drink the pure nectar of the holy name. There is nothing but
the name to be had in the fourteen worlds. It has filled the
soul of Śrī Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura.

items.title: Vibhāvarī Śeṣa — End of Night
items.author: Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura
items.source: Kalyāṇa Kalpataru, Ucchvāsa: Ucchvāsa Kīrtana: Nāma Kīrtana Song 2
items.chanting_mood: Names cascade at dawn — the tongue warms on Krishna's names before the maha-mantra.
items.audio_note: Prabhupāda's own rendering. The same folder also holds his Bengali purport (companion track 02).
items.meditation_for_japa:
Sing at the close of night. The bhajan is itself a procession of
Krishna's names; by the eighth verse the tongue has been
decisively tuned. The maha-mantra that follows is the natural
next breath.

verses.iast:
vibhāvarī śeṣa, āloka-praveśa,
nidrā chāḍi' uṭho jīva
bolo hari hari, mukunda murāri,
rāma kṛṣṇa hayagrīva
verses.translation:
The night has come to an end and the light of dawn is entering.
O jīva soul, arise and give up your sleep. Chant the holy names
of Lord Hari, who is the giver of liberation; the enemy of the
Mura demon; the supreme enjoyer; the all-attractive one; and
the horse-headed incarnation, Hayagrīva.

verses.iast:
nṛsiṁha vāmana, śrī-madhusūdana,
brajendra-nandana śyāma
pūtanā-ghātana, kaiṭabha-śātana,
jaya dāśarathi-rāma
verses.translation:
Lord Hari [Kṛṣṇa] incarnated as the half-man, half-lion,
Nṛsiṁha. He appeared as a dwarf-brāhmaṇa named Upendra and is
the killer of the Madhu demon. He is the beloved son of the
King of Vraja, Nanda Mahārāja, and is blackish in complexion.
He is the slayer of the Pūtanā witch and the destroyer of the
demon Kaiṭabha. All glories to Lord Hari, who appeared as Lord
Rāma, the son of King Daśaratha.

verses.iast:
yaśodā dulāla, govinda-gopāla,
vṛndāvana purandara
gopī-priya-jana, rādhikā-ramaṇa,
bhuvana-sundara-bara
verses.translation:
He is the darling of mother Yaśodā; the giver of pleasure to
the cows, land, and spiritual senses; and the protector of the
cows. He is the Lord of the Vṛndāvana forest; the gopīs'
beloved; the lover of Rādhikā, and the most beautiful
personality in all the worlds.

verses.iast:
rāvāṇāntakara, mākhana-taskara,
gopī-jana-vastra-hārī
brajera rākhāla, gopa-vṛnda-pāla,
citta-hārī baṁśī-dhārī
verses.translation:
As Rāmacandra He brought about the end of the demoniac King
Rāvaṇa; as Kṛṣṇa He stole the older gopīs' butter; He stole
the younger gopīs' clothes while they were bathing in the
Yamunā. He is a cowherd boy of Vraja and the protector of the
cowherd boys. He steals the hearts of all and always holds a
flute.

verses.iast:
yogīndra-vandana, śrī-nanda-nandana,
braja-jana-bhaya-hārī
navīna nīrada, rūpa manohara,
mohana-baṁśī-bihārī
verses.translation:
Lord Kṛṣṇa is worshiped by the best of yogīs and is the son of
Nanda. He removes all the fears of the inhabitants of Vraja.
He is the color of a fresh rain cloud, and His form is
enchanting. When He wanders about, playing His flute, He looks
very charming.

verses.iast:
yaśodā-nandana, kaṁsa-nisūdana,
nikuñja-rāsa-vilāsī
kadamba-kānana, rāsa-parāyaṇa,
bṛnda-vipina-nivāsī
verses.translation:
He is the son of Yaśodā and the killer of King Kaṁsa, and He
sports in the rāsa dance among the groves of Vraja. Kṛṣṇa
engages in the rāsa dance underneath the kadamba trees, and He
resides in the forest of Vṛndāvana.

verses.iast:
ānanda-vardhana, prema-niketana,
phula-śara-jojaka kāma
gopāṅganā-gaṇa, citta-vinodana,
samasta-guṇa-gaṇa-dhāma
verses.translation:
He increases the ecstasy of His devotees. He is the reservoir
of all love and is the transcendental Cupid who uses His
flowered arrows to increase the loving desires of the gopīs.
He is the pleasure of the gopīs' hearts and the abode of all
wonderful qualities.

verses.iast:
jāmuna-jīvana, keli-parāyaṇa,
mānasa-candra-cakora
nāma-sudhā-rasa, gāo kṛṣṇa-yaśa,
rākho vacana mana mora
verses.translation:
Lord Kṛṣṇa is the life of the River Yamunā. He is always
absorbed in amorous pastimes, and He is the moon of the gopīs'
minds, which are like the cakora birds that subsist only upon
moonlight. O mind, obey these words of mine and sing the
glories of Śrī Kṛṣṇa in the form of these holy names, which
are full of nectarean mellows.

items.title: Yaśomatī Nandana — Śrī Nāma Kīrtana
items.author: Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura
items.source: Gītāvalī, Nāma Kīrtana Song 1 (Chanting of the Holy Names)
items.chanting_mood: Direct chanting of Krishna's names — the qualities of the Name made manifest.
items.audio_note: Prabhupāda's own rendering, Vol-04 bhajan collection.
items.meditation_for_japa:
The bhajan IS the chanting, distilled. Each verse names Krishna by
a quality; the names accumulate; by verse 4 the tongue is awake.
Begin japa immediately after.

verses.iast:
yaśomatī-nandana, braja-baro-nāgara,
gokula-rañjana kāna
gopī-parāṇa-dhana, madana-manohara,
kāliya-damana-vidhāna
verses.translation:
Kṛṣṇa is the beloved son of mother Yaśodā; the transcendental
lover in the land of Vraja; the delight of Gokula; Kāna [a
nickname of Kṛṣṇa]; the wealth of the lives of the gopīs. He
steals the mind of even Cupid and punishes the Kāliya serpent.

verses.iast:
amala harināma amiya-vilāsā
vipina-purandara, navīna nāgara-bora,
baṁśī-badana suvāsā
verses.translation:
These pure, holy names of Lord Hari are full of sweet,
nectarean pastimes. Kṛṣṇa is the lord of the twelve forests of
Vraja, He is ever-youthful and is the best of lovers. He is
always playing on a flute, and He is an excellent dresser.

verses.iast:
braja-jana-pālana, asura-kula-nāśana,
nanda-godhana-rākhowālā
govinda mādhava, navanīta-taskara,
sundara nanda-gopālā
verses.translation:
Kṛṣṇa is the protector of the inhabitants of Vraja; the
destroyer of various demoniac dynasties; the keeper and tender
of Nanda Mahārāja's cows; the giver of pleasure to the cows,
land, and spiritual senses; the husband of the goddess of
fortune; the butter thief; and the beautiful cowherd boy of
Nanda Mahārāja.

verses.iast:
yāmuna-taṭa-cara, gopī-basana-hara,
rāsa-rasika, kṛpāmoya
śrī-rādhā-vallabha, vṛndābana-naṭabara,
bhaktivinoda-āśraya
verses.translation:
Kṛṣṇa wanders along the banks of the River Yamunā. He stole
the garments of the young damsels of Vraja when they were
bathing there. He delights in the mellows of the rāsa dance;
He is very merciful; the lover and beloved of Śrīmatī
Rādhārāṇī; the great dancer of Vṛndāvana; and the shelter and
only refuge of Ṭhākura Bhaktivinoda.

items.title: Hari Haraye Namaḥ Kṛṣṇa Yādavāya Namaḥ — Nāma Saṅkīrtana
items.author: Narottama Dāsa Ṭhākura
items.chanting_mood: Saṅkīrtana itself — Krishna's names + the Goswāmīs invoked together.
items.audio_note: Prabhupāda's own rendering from Songs of the Spiritual Masters.
items.meditation_for_japa:
Sing the refrain. The bhajan is a saṅkīrtana in itself; by the
tenth verse you have invoked Krishna's chief names, the
Pañca-tattva, Śrī Bhāgavatam, and the Six Goswāmīs. Begin japa
with that lineage in mind.
items.refrain:
hari haraye namaḥ, kṛṣṇa yādavāya namaḥ,
yādavāya mādhavāya keśavāya namaḥ

verses.iast:
hari haraye namaḥ kṛṣṇa yādavāya namaḥ
yādavāya mādhavāya keśavāya namaḥ
verses.translation:
O Lord Hari, obeisances unto You! O Kṛṣṇa, O Yādava, obeisances
to You! Obeisances unto the Lord of the Yadus, Mādhava,
Keśava!

verses.iast:
gopāla govinda rāma śrī-madhusūdana
giridhārī gopīnātha madana-mohana
verses.translation:
O Gopāla! O Govinda! O Rāma! O vanquisher of Madhu! O Giridhārī!
O Lord of the gopīs! O Bewilderer of cupid!

verses.iast:
śrī-caitanya-nityānanda śrī-advaita-sītā
hari guru vaiṣṇaba bhāgavata gītā
verses.translation:
Śrī Caitanya, Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita-Sītā! Hari! Guru!
Vaiṣṇavas! Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam! Bhagavad-gītā!

verses.iast:
śrī-rūpa sanātana bhaṭṭa-raghunātha
śrī-jīva gopāla-bhaṭṭa dāsa-raghunātha
verses.translation:
All glories to Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī and
Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, to Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī, Gopāla
Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī and Raghunātha Dāsa Gosvāmī!

verses.iast:
ei chay gosāñi kori caraṇa vandan
jāhā hoite bighna-nāś abhīṣṭa-pūraṇ
verses.translation:
I bow to the feet of these six Gosvāmīs. By their grace all
obstacles can be destroyed and all desires are fulfilled.

verses.iast:
ei chay gosāi jār — mui tār dās
tā-sabāra pada-reṇu mora pañca-grās
verses.translation:
I am the servant of these six Gosvāmīs. The dust of their feet
is my fivefold sustenance.

verses.iast:
tādera caraṇa-sebi-bhakata-sane bās
janame janame hoy ei abhilāṣ
verses.translation:
To be a servant of their lotus feet and to reside in the
company of devotees — this is my aspiration birth after birth.

verses.iast:
ei chay gosāi jabe braje koilā bās
rādhā-kṛṣṇa-nitya-līlā korilā prakāś
verses.translation:
When these six Gosvāmīs lived in Vraja, they revealed the
eternal pastimes of Śrī Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

verses.iast:
ānande bolo hari bhaja vṛndāban
śrī-guru-vaiṣṇaba-pade mājāiyā man
verses.translation:
In ecstasy, sing the names of Lord Hari and worship Vṛndāvana,
joyfully fixing your mind upon the lotus feet of the bona fide
spiritual master and the pure devotees.

verses.iast:
śrī-guru-vaiṣṇaba-pada-padma kori āś
nāma-saṅkīrtana kohe narottama dāsa
verses.translation:
The lotus feet of my guru and the vaiṣṇavas are my aspiration.
Narottama Dāsa thus sings Hari-nāma-saṅkīrtana.

items.title: Hari Hari Biphale Janama Goṅāinu
items.author: Narottama Dāsa Ṭhākura
items.source: Prārthanā, Dainya Bodhikā Song 2 — Iṣṭa Deve Vijñapti (Prayer to One's Beloved Lord)
items.chanting_mood: The lament that the Name has not yet attracted us — the qualifying humility.
items.audio_note: Prabhupāda's own rendering from Songs of the Spiritual Masters.
items.meditation_for_japa:
The qualifying mood for sincere japa is not confidence but lament.
Read this when chanting has gone dry — it voices the heart's
honest admission and the prayer that becomes attractive.

verses.iast:
hari hari! bifale janama goṅāinu
manuṣya-janama pāiyā, rādhā-kṛṣṇa nā bhajiyā,
jāniyā śuniyā biṣa khāinu
verses.translation:
O Lord Hari, I have spent my life uselessly. Having obtained a
human birth and having not worshiped Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, I have
knowingly drunk poison.

verses.iast:
golokera prema-dhana, hari-nāma-saṅkīrtana,
rati nā janmilo kene tāy
saṁsāra-biṣānale, dibā-niśi hiyā jvale,
jurāite nā koinu upāy
verses.translation:
The treasure of divine love in Goloka Vṛndāvana has descended
as the congregational chanting of Lord Hari's holy names. Why
did my attraction for that chanting never come about? Day and
night my heart burns from the fire of the poison of worldliness,
and I have not taken the means to relieve it.

verses.iast:
brajendra-nandana jei, śacī-suta hoilo sei,
balarāma hoilo nitāi
dīna-hīna jata chilo, hari-nāme uddhārilo,
tā'ra sākṣī jagāi mādhāi
verses.translation:
O Lord Kṛṣṇa, who is the son of the King of Vraja, became the
son of Saci (Lord Caitanya), and Balarāma became Nitāi. The
holy name delivered all those souls who were lowly and
wretched. The two sinners Jagāi and Mādhāi are evidence of
this.

verses.iast:
hā hā prabhu nanda-suta, vṛṣabhānu-sutā-juta,
karuṇā karoho ei-bāro
narottama-dāsa koy, nā ṭheliho rāṅgā pāy,
tomā bine ke āche āmāra
verses.translation:
O Lord Kṛṣṇa, son of Nanda, accompanied by the daughter of
Vṛṣabhānu, please be merciful to me now. Narottama Dāsa says,
"O Lord, please do not push me away from Your reddish lotus
feet, for who is my beloved except for You?"

items.title: Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Prabhu Doyā Koro More
items.author: Narottama Dāsa Ṭhākura
items.source: Prārthanā, Punaḥ Prārthanā Song 1 — Sāvaraṇa-śrī-gaura-pāda-padme (A Prayer to the Lotus Feet of Śrī Gaurāṅga)
items.chanting_mood: Calling for Mahāprabhu's mercy — He alone makes the Name taste sweet.
items.audio_note: Prabhupāda's own rendering, Vol-04 bhajan collection.
items.meditation_for_japa:
Mahāprabhu came expressly to give the chanting; only His mercy
makes the rounds taste sweet. Read this when you feel empty before
japa. This is the precise request to make.

verses.iast:
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya prabhu doyā koro more
tomā binā ke doyālu jagat-saṁsāre
verses.translation:
O my Lord Caitanya, please be merciful to me, because no one
can be more merciful than Your Lordship within these three
worlds.

verses.iast:
patita-pāvana-hetu tava avatāra
mo sama patita prabhu nā pāibe āra
verses.translation:
Your incarnation is just to reclaim the conditioned, fallen
souls, but I assure You that You will not find a greater
fallen soul than me. Therefore, my claim is first.

verses.iast:
hā hā prabhu nityānanda, premānanda sukhī
kṛpābalokana koro āmi boro duḥkhī
verses.translation:
My dear Lord Nityānanda, You are always joyful in spiritual
bliss. Since You always appear very happy, I have come to You
because I am most unhappy. If You kindly put Your glance over
me, then I may also become happy.

verses.iast:
doyā koro sītā-pati adwaita gosāñi
tava kṛpā-bale pāi caitanya-nitāi
verses.translation:
My dear Advaita Prabhu, husband of Sītā, You are so kind.
Please be merciful to me. If You are kind to me, naturally
Lord Caitanya and Nityānanda will also be kind to me.

verses.iast:
hā hā svarūp, sanātana, rūpa, raghunātha
bhaṭṭa-juga, śrī-jīva hā prabhu lokanātha
verses.translation:
O Svarūpa Dāmodara, personal secretary of Lord Caitanya, O six
Gosvāmīs — Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa
Gosvāmī, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, Jīva Gosvāmī, and Raghunātha
Dāsa Gosvāmī! O Lokanātha Gosvāmī, my beloved spiritual master!
Narottama Dāsa also prays for Your mercy.

verses.iast:
doyā koro śrī-ācārya prabhu śrīnivāsa
rāmacandra-saṅga māge narottama-dāsa
verses.translation:
O Śrīnivāsa Ācārya, successor to the six Gosvāmīs! Please be
merciful to me. Narottama Dāsa always desires the company of
Rāmacandra Cakravartī.

items.title: Gaurāṅga Bolite Habe — Lālasāmayī Prārthanā
items.author: Narottama Dāsa Ṭhākura
items.chanting_mood: Longing — when will the Name itself bring ecstatic tears?
items.audio_note: Direct recording not yet pinned. Browse the Gauranga Bhajan folder (Vol-01) for related Prabhupāda renderings — Gaurāṅgera Duṭi Pada and Gaurā Pahū are there.
items.meditation_for_japa:
The bhajan voices the question every sincere chanter eventually
reaches: when will the Name itself bring tears? Approach today's
rounds with that honest, longing question.

verses.iast:
'gaurāṅga' bolite habe pulaka-śarīra
'hari hari' bolite nayane ba'be nīra
verses.translation:
When will that opportune moment come to us when there will be
shivering of the body as soon as we chant Lord Gaurāṅga's
name? While chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa, when will there be tears in
the eyes?

verses.iast:
āra kabe nitāi-cāṅder koruṇā hoibe
saṁsāra-bāsanā mora tuccha ha'be
verses.translation:
When will I obtain the mercy of Lord Nityānandacandra? When,
by His mercy, will the desire for material enjoyment become
very insignificant?

verses.iast:
viṣaya chāḍiyā kabe śuddha ha'be mana
kabe hāma herabo śrī-bṛndābana
verses.translation:
When the mind is completely purified, being freed from
material anxieties and desires, then I shall be able to
understand Vṛndāvana and the conjugal love of Rādhā and
Kṛṣṇa, and then my spiritual life will be successful.

verses.iast:
rūpa-raghunātha-pade hoibe ākuti
kabe hāma bujhabo se jugala-pirīti
verses.translation:
When shall I be very much eager to study the books left by the
Six Gosvāmīs, headed by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrīla
Raghunātha Dāsa Gosvāmī? By their instruction I shall be able
to properly understand the loving affairs of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

verses.iast:
rūpa-raghunātha-pade rahu mora āśa
prārthanā koroye sadā narottama-dāsa
verses.translation:
My only aspiration is to attain the lotus feet of the Six
Gosvāmīs headed by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrīla Raghunātha
Dāsa Gosvāmī. Narottama Dāsa constantly prays to attain their
lotus feet.

items.title: Gaurāṅgera Duṭi Pada — The Glories of Śrī Gaurāṅga
items.author: Narottama Dāsa Ṭhākura
items.chanting_mood: Gauranga's lotus feet as the qualifier — only by His feet does devotion become real.
items.audio_note: Prabhupāda's own rendering, Gauranga Bhajan folder Vol-01.
items.meditation_for_japa:
The bhajan unfolds the consequences of accepting Gaurāṅga's feet:
taste, ecstasy, understanding of pastimes, association with the
devotees. Read it once and approach japa with one specific verse
held in mind for that round.

verses.iast:
gaurāṅgera duṭi pada, jār dhana sampada,
se jāne bhakati-rasa-sār
gaurāṅgera madhura-līlā, jāra karṇe praveśilā,
hṛdoya nirmala bhelo tār
verses.translation:
Anyone who has accepted the two lotus feet of Lord Caitanya
can understand the true essence of devotional service. If one
is captivated by the pleasing pastimes of Lord Caitanya, the
dirty things in his heart will all become cleansed.

verses.iast:
je gaurāṅgera nāma loy, tāra hoy premodoy,
tāre mui jāi bolihāri
gaurāṅga-guṇete jhure, nitya-līlā tāre sphure,
se jana bhakati-adhikārī
verses.translation:
One who simply takes the holy name of Gaurasundara, Śrī Kṛṣṇa
Caitanya, will immediately develop love of God. To such a
person I say: "Bravo! Very nice! Excellent!" If one
appreciates the merciful pastimes of Lord Caitanya and feels
ecstasy and sometimes cries, this process will immediately
help him to understand the eternal pastimes of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa.

verses.iast:
gaurāṅgera saṅgi-gaṇe, nitya-siddha kori māne,
se jāy brajendra-suta-pāś
śrī-gauḍa-maṇḍala-bhūmi, jebā jāne cintāmaṇi,
tāra hoy braja-bhūme bās
verses.translation:
Simply by understanding that the associates of Lord Gaurāṅga
are eternally free from material contamination, one can
immediately be promoted to the transcendental abode of Lord
Kṛṣṇa. If one simply understands that the land of Navadvīpa is
not different from Vṛndāvana, then he actually lives in
Vṛndāvana.

verses.iast:
gaura-prema-rasārṇave, śe taraṅge jebā ḍube,
se rādhā-mādhava-antaraṅga
gṛhe vā vanete thāke, 'hā gaurāṅga' bo'le ḍāke,
narottama māge tāra saṅga
verses.translation:
If one says: "Let me dive deep into the waves of the
nectarean transcendental loving movement introduced by Lord
Caitanya," he immediately becomes one of the confidential
devotees of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa. It does not matter whether one
is a householder living at home or a vānaprastha or sannyāsī
living in the forest, if he chants "O Gaurāṅga," and becomes
a devotee of Lord Caitanya, then Narottama Dāsa begs to have
his association.
